displayName.text: Uncle Jerry's Pasta 傑利叔叔義大利麵

text.text: A fast serving pasta spaghetti restaurant that provides a quick bite for students and works around this area. Food was alright for it's pricing, dont expect high quality gourmet dishes or taste as the owner only charges you NT$200 per serving.

originalText.text: A fast serving pasta spaghetti restaurant that provides a quick bite for students and works around this area. Food was alright for it's pricing, dont expect high quality gourmet dishes or taste as the owner only charges you NT$200 per serving.

text.text: Although we had to use Google translate in ordering food we were all satisfied with what we've chosen. Love that the pasta is al dente without being oily. Pumpkin sauce penne pasta, aglio olio chicken penne , baked cheesy beef spaghetti and old fashioned tomato sauce beef spaghetti were cooked perfectly according to our palate

text.text:
Surprise on a rainy day~ Due to heavy rain, we decided to find somewhere close to MRT Zhongxiao Fuxing Exit 14 to dine.
We were welcomed by friendly staff, the foods were affordable and delicious! There are many flavors to choose from. You can customize your dish by choosing between spaghetti, penne, or rice. There are options to upgrade your dish and make it a full course meal. The spiciness can also be customized. You would order and pay at the counter first and there is no 10% service charge. On the side of the counter, there is self served water and winter melon tea. Overall, it was a great experience for us, we really enjoyed it!
